block.prompt: Read the statements about Emma. Write T (true) or F (false). For FALSE statements, write the correct information.

statements: Emma's dad lives with the family every day.
Emma thinks she is good at Maths.
Emma has already travelled outside the UK.
Looking at travel photos makes Emma feel only happy.

block.answer_key: 1. F — He only comes home at weekends / works in another city during the week. 2. F — She thinks she is still not very good. 3. F — She has never been outside the UK. 4. F — It makes her feel both excited and a little sad.
block.acceptable_reasoning: Sinngemäße Korrekturen sind akzeptabel; Direktzitate aus dem Text sind ebenfalls gültig.
watch_outs: Statement 4 ist die wichtigste Aufgabe zur Emotionserkennung: 'both … and' zeigt ambivalente Gefühle — kein einfaches Entweder-Oder
Schüler:innen neigen dazu, nur 'excited' zu notieren und 'sad' zu übersehen
